source.author: verg
source.text: Hic vasto rex Aeolus antro luctantes ventos tempestatesque sonoras imperio premit ac vinclis et carcere frenat.
source.text_original: Hic vasto rex Aeolus antro / luctantes ventos tempestatesque sonoras / imperio premit ac vinclis et carcere frenat.
source.text_english: Here in a vast cave King Aeolus holds in check the struggling winds and the roaring storms by his authority, and restrains them with chains and prison.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Graia novam ferro molem commenta iuventus pergit et ingenti gaudens domat aequora velo, nec mihi libertas imis freta tollere harenis, qualis eram nondum vinclis et carcere clausus.
reuse.text_original: Graia novam ferro molem commenta iuventus / pergit et ingenti gaudens domat aequora velo, / nec mihi libertas imis freta tollere harenis, / qualis eram nondum vinclis et carcere clausus.
reuse.text_english: The Greek youth goes on devising a new mass of iron and, rejoicing, subdues the seas with a great sail, nor is it freedom for me to lift the deep waters from the lowest sands, such as I was before, not yet shut in by chains and prison.
